LanguageData.Merthsoft_TimeOfDaySwitches_RequireOccup: Require a living pawn in an enclosed room as well as the enabled schedule and manual switch. Sleeping pawns, animals, and pawns of any faction count. Wall placement must border exactly one enclosed room. No valid room or multiple rooms keeps power off. Checks every 250 game ticks (about four seconds at normal speed). Copy/paste copies the schedule only.
